claims.text: The approach improves model training transparency by using keywords that provide human-understandable explanations for the model's decisions.
Empirical results show that the approach enhances interpretability and accuracy, improving state-of-the-art performance by 24.3%.
The method allows for human involvement in labeling and understanding model behavior, which contributes to interpretability.
